items.title: 11-term House rep who mocked a kid’s letter about EVs has lost her seat (Upd.)
items.summary: An 83 year old Congressional representative who sent an embarrassing letter to a well-meaning 10 year old constituent on the topic of electric cars and climate change, where she seems to brag about saddling his generation with debt through a recent climate rollback she voted for, has lost her seat. Update: This article was originally posted on May 14, but we wanted to update it with news of the election result. After a recount, Chuck Hubbard has defeated Virginia Foxx by 330 votes, and will go on to represent NC-5 in Congress. more…

And now, you can buy one. more…

items.title: 4-in-1 Raspberry Pi HAT combines RTL-SDR, LoRa, GPS, and RTC
items.summary: Guangzhou-based HackerGadgets has launched a 4-in-1 Raspberry Pi HAT that offers RTL-SDR and LoRa connectivity, GPS and Beidou/GLONASS GNSS, and a PCF85063A real-time clock (RTC). The SDR part is implemented through an RTL2832U+R860 combo supporting 100 kHz to 1.74 GHz frequency and 100 kHz-28.8 MHz HF direct sampling. The HAT also features a Semtech SX1262 LoRa transceiver supporting the 860-960 MHz frequency band, 22 dBm max output power, and Meshtastic firmware. Users can select between U.FL and SMA versions depending on the type of antennas they plan to use. RTL-SDR/LoRa/GPS/RTC HAT specifications: Compatibility Raspberry Pi 3B, 4B, and 5 – Direct installation. Raspberry Pi Zero and Zero 2 W – Direct installation if the board has a 40-pin header; check overall height and power capacity.
